changes.title: Cite the predecessor repository's issues by name
changes.summary: Comments, SPEC text and test titles that cited issues and pull requests of the predecessor repository by bare number now cite them as crowncodes/ia#N, so they no longer resolve to unrelated items in this repository. Comments, documentation and test titles only; no behaviour, export, output or dependency changes.

changes.title: Refresh the package READMEs for 3.1
changes.summary: Each package README now has a badge row, a short summary, a verified quick start or example, its main commands or exports, its limits and links, in the voice of the repository README. The CLI README is the 3.x command guide: preview and author, mandate checks and --actor, the removal of ia compile, Claude Code and Codex as the supported hosts, and the 3.1 host plugin commands ia init --from and ia project --product plugin. The compliance README shows the opt-in conformance evidence and the workspace-runtime README the host plugin subpaths. Documentation only; no package behaviour, export or dependency changes.

changes.title: Self-contained phase rows in generated position packets
changes.summary: The position packet that `ia project` and `ia host` write (`.claude/rules/ia-workspace.md` for Claude Code, `AGENTS.md` for Codex) no longer cites a decision record outside this repository. Each phase row now reads `--phase selects the playbook cell delivered and decides which conditional relation rows apply`. The packet text and its digest change, so `ia doctor` reports a projection an earlier version wrote as outdated until `ia project <host> --apply` writes it again. Nothing else in the packet, the position body or the delivery view changes.

changes.title: Cite public sources in package contracts and comments
changes.summary: Package SPECs, source comments and test titles state each rule, or cite the public SPEC clause or docs/specs section that states it, instead of planning milestones, tasks, amendments, design rows, review-finding ids and decision names that live outside this repository. Comments, documentation and test titles only; no behaviour, export, output or dependency changes.

changes.title: Cite public contracts in package sources
changes.summary: Package contracts, source comments and tests cite the public SPEC clauses that state each rule instead of planning documents kept outside this repository. No behaviour, export or dependency changes.

changes.title: Coordinated version alignment
changes.summary: Package and native artifact version metadata follows the coordinated 3.1.1 release.

changes.title: Repository maintenance
changes.summary: Tooling, workflow, documentation and release bookkeeping outside the published package contents.
